name: Matt Flick
biography: For more than 9 years, Matt Flick has developed his career in the information security industry, with expertise in application security and other areas within information security management, services, and auditing. Matt has worked with both commercial and federal government clients to help plan, develop, and assess their information security programs. Matt is currently a Principal with FYRM Associates Inc., an information security professional services organization, and a member of OWASP DC, ISACA and ISSA. Mr. Flick has previously presented at Blackhat DC 2009.
